title: Keyboard-only navigation deep audit (WCAG 2.1.1 / 2.1.2 / 2.4.3 / 2.4.7)
head: d601fdd34
scope: Audit Vue components for keyboard support across POS / Kiosk / KDS / Admin surfaces. Verify J-STEP-POS findings (P3-FRICTION-1, P7-FRICTION-3, PosCounterCollect no-Enter, KdsHistoryDrawer Escape). Source-grep WCAG 2.1.1/2.1.2/2.4.3/2.4.7 compliance per surface, write Vitest source-grep sentinel, identify deferred power-user gaps.
verdict_rationale: WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) PASS: every interactive element on the audited surfaces has a click handler that is reachable via Enter or Space when the focus arrives there, OR sits behind a native button/anchor that is keyboard-focusable by default. WCAG 2.1.2 (No Keyboard Trap) PASS: Kiosk wizard uses a documented Tab-cycling trap with focus restore on close; no other surface holds focus. WCAG 2.4.3 (Focus Order) PASS for the audited screens — DOM order matches visual order on PaymentComponent, PosCounterCollectModal, KdsHistoryDrawer, KioskWizardComponent (vertical-flow forms + segmented controls). WCAG 2.4.7 (Focus Visible) PASS: app.css ships a global :focus-visible ring (3px solid #1d4ed8) on buttons + [role=button], and per-surface rings on .kiosk-touch-btn, .cv1-step-tab, .pos-v5-payment-confirm, .pos-v5-payment-input. NO V1 ship blocker. 5 power-user FRICTION gaps remain — all deferred to V1.0.2 per J-STEP-POS owner verdict + the absence of a global POS keyboard-shortcuts composable. Sentinel 18/18 GREEN locks the current good baseline so regression is detectable in CI.

scope_audited.playwright_live_runs: Live axe-core sweep is L5.1's lane; this agent's verdict is source-grep + cross-reference with prior Phase J / G2 captures. No new screenshots taken.

2_1_1_keyboard.rationale: Every interactive element on POS PaymentComponent, PosCounterCollectModal, KdsHistoryDrawer, KdsOrderCard, KioskWizardComponent, KioskPaymentComponent, KioskCartComponent, KioskUpsellComponent, KsChip, and the kiosk idle screen is either a native <button>/<input>/<select> (keyboard-focusable by default) OR carries explicit @keydown.enter/@keydown.space bindings (e.g. KdsOrderCard tabindex=0 + @keydown.enter, KioskIdleScreenComponent tabindex=0 + @keydown.enter/space → openSettings).
exemplary_patterns: KioskPaymentComponent.vue:59-122 — every payment method tile carries BOTH @keydown.enter.prevent and @keydown.space.prevent (selectMethod). 9 total bindings (3 modes × 3 keys = 9 lines verified).
KdsOrderCard.vue:21-25 — card root has tabindex=0 + role=region + aria-label + @keydown.enter=onCardKeydownEnter.
KioskCartComponent.vue:293 — @keydown.enter.prevent on the promo input lets the customer submit without reaching the Apply button.

2_1_2_no_keyboard_trap.rationale: Kiosk wizard installs a Tab-cycling trap (KioskWizardComponent.vue:2219-2238) that wraps Tab and Shift+Tab around the focusables INSIDE the wizard root. The trap is paired with a return-focus restorer on unmount (lines 2212, 2276-2280) so the caller surface regains focus. The abandon-confirm dialog has its own Escape-handler (line 2292) that calls onAbandonCancel — focus can always escape. No other surface installs a focus trap. KdsHistoryDrawer is a SLIDE-IN PANEL (not a true blocking dialog) — backdrop click + Escape both close it (line 195).
exemplary_patterns: KioskWizardComponent.vue:2225 — focusables query uses standard selector 'button:not([disabled]), [href], input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'.

2_4_3_focus_order.rationale: PaymentComponent.vue DOM flow: close button → method tabs (cash/card/multi) → cash input → terminal select → card input → numpad → multi-block (split-count → equal-button → tranche rows → add-tranche) → confirm. Matches visual top-to-bottom + left-to-right. PosCounterCollectModal flow: close → mode picker (CASH/CARD/MOBILE/TICKET) → cash input → numpad → change-row → cancel → confirm. Linear and matches visual. KdsHistoryDrawer flow: title + close → retry-on-error → list. No CSS order-reversing tricks used (no `order:` property, no flex-direction:row-reverse on focusable groups, no float).
2_4_3_focus_order.negative_check: grep 'flex-direction:.*reverse\|order:.*[0-9]' on the audited Vue components = 0 hits in focusable scope.

2_4_7_focus_visible.rationale: Global focus-visible contract is enforced in public/css/app.css lines 26-29: button:focus-visible + [role="button"]:focus-visible → outline: 3px solid #1d4ed8 + outline-offset: 2px + border-radius. Per-surface rings: .cv1-step-tab:focus-visible (line 186), .pos-v5-shell *:focus-visible (line 437), .kiosk-touch-btn / .kiosk-touch-option / .kiosk-counter-btn :focus-visible (lines 2249-2252, 3px solid var(--kiosk-primary)). PaymentComponent inputs use border-color + box-shadow 0 0 0 3px var(--pos-v5-brand-red-soft) on :focus (line 1218-1222). PosCounterCollectModal .cc-input:focus = box-shadow 0 0 0 3px brand-red-soft (line 631-635).
2_4_7_focus_visible.caveat: Two Tailwind-generated `.focus-visible\:outline-none` classes exist (app.css:9898) but only apply when the developer adds the Tailwind class explicitly — not a global suppression. No `outline: 0 !important` on focusable selectors detected (only on the kiosk wizard root tabindex=-1 wrapper, which is correct because it is a programmatic focus target, not a Tab-stop).

findings.summary: PaymentComponent (FROZEN §7) has ZERO Enter-to-confirm on cashInput / cardInput. Cashier types '50' → must mouse-click ✓ Confirmer. No global Ctrl+Enter / F-key submit. No @keyup.enter binding on the confirm button or the inputs.

evidence.verified_lines: 86-93 (cashInput, only v-on:keypress=floatNumber for digit filtering), 143-149 (cardInput, type=number, no keyup binding), 308-319 (confirm button, only @click=confirmOrder, no @keydown)

findings.owner_path: FROZEN per CLAUDE.md §7 — any heal requires LOCK_PAY plan + owner countersign + sentinel.
recommendation_TEXT_ONLY_NO_PATCH: Option A (V1.0.2): Add `@keyup.enter="confirmOrder"` to the cashInput AND cardInput inputs. Guarded by the existing :disabled gates on confirmOrder (loading + canConfirmCard + canConfirmMulti) so a stray Enter on the input never bypasses validation. LOC ~4. Requires LOCK_PAY because of §7. Add Vitest case `confirmOrder is invoked when Enter pressed on cashInput while canConfirmCard=true`.

Option B (V1.0.2): Auto-focus cashInput on modal mount via this.$refs.cashInput.focus() in mounted() (after this.fetchPaymentTerminals). Combined with Option A, cashier can type → Enter without ever touching the mouse. Mirror the kiosk wizard's setTimeout(150) pattern to wait for modal CSS transition.

Option C (DEFER V2): Introduce a global POS keyboard-shortcuts composable usePosKeyboard() — F1=cash, F2=card, F3=multi, ESC=cancel, Ctrl+Enter=confirm. Larger surface, would touch PosComponent + PaymentComponent (frozen) + PosCounterCollectModal. Backlog per J-STEP-POS P3-FRICTION-1.

findings.summary: PosCounterCollectModal (NOT frozen) lacks Enter-to-confirm on the received-amount input AND lacks Escape-to-cancel on the modal AND does NOT auto-focus receivedInput on open. Cashier flow on a cash-pending kiosk order is: click row → modal opens → mouse-pickup → click receivedInput → type → mouse-pickup → click ✓ Confirmer. Two mouse hops where one keyboard would do.

verified: Line 106-116: receivedInput input with v-on:keypress=onlyFloat (digit filter only) — NO @keyup.enter, NO @keydown.enter
Lines 164-176: confirm button only @click=onConfirm, no @keydown binding
Lines 308-353: methods setMode/numpadInput/etc — NO focus() call anywhere
Line 295: order watcher triggers on order change but does NOT focus the input

findings.owner_path: Modal is NOT frozen — surgical patch viable per inline-edit exception (≤30 lignes + tests immédiats + hors frozen-zone).
recommendation_TEXT_ONLY_NO_PATCH: Bind `@keyup.enter="onConfirm"` on receivedInput AND on the modal root. Add a document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onEsc) in mounted() (mirror KdsHistoryDrawer.vue:189-204 pattern, including the open-guard + removeEventListener in beforeUnmount). Auto-focus receivedInput on watch(order, immediate:true) via this.$nextTick(() => this.$refs.receivedInput?.focus()).
LOC ~12. No §7 conflict. Add Vitest case: source-grep that the file declares @keyup.enter on the receivedInput AND a document keydown listener for Escape.

findings.summary: Cash Overview (CashOverviewComponent.vue) has ZERO keyboard handlers (@keydown/@keyup/@keypress = 0 matches). Filters (date range, branch, mode) are reachable via Tab but no Enter-to-apply on the date input AND no global shortcut to switch tabs (Recettes / Encaisseurs / Réconciliation). Each filter change relies on native <select> change events, which is keyboard-fine. The friction is only the absence of power-user shortcuts.
findings.owner_path: V1.0.2 backlog — Admin daily not a hot-rush surface. No POS-style shortcut bar.
findings.recommendation_TEXT_ONLY_NO_PATCH: No change recommended for V1. If owner ships a tabbed power-user surface in V1.0.X, add Alt+1..Alt+3 to switch tabs via a small mixin.

findings.summary: Admin item edit form (resources/js/components/admin/items/ItemComponent.vue + ItemCreateComponent.vue) has ZERO @keydown/@keyup/@keypress/tabindex bindings (raw grep returns nothing). Form is keyboard-usable because every field is a native <input>/<select>/<textarea>, but Enter on a non-final input in the multi-field form will submit the wrapping <form> if one exists (no @submit.prevent guard verified inside the inspected components — that risk lives in the parent template).
findings.owner_path: V1.0.2 polish. Not on the kitchen rush hot-path.
findings.recommendation_TEXT_ONLY_NO_PATCH: Confirm <form @submit.prevent='save'> is present on the wrapper Blade view; if not, an Enter on the SKU field could submit the form mid-edit. Add a sentinel that source-greps for @submit.prevent in admin items Blade views (out of L5.3 scope — flag for L5.x consolidation).

findings.summary: PaymentComponent #orderpayment modal lacks an explicit Escape-to-close binding. The pos-v5-payment-close button (X) handles mouse-close but Escape is silently swallowed — there is no document.addEventListener('keydown'). The cashier must Tab to the X button and press Enter, OR click outside (no @click.self on overlay either — modal sits in a Bootstrap-managed dialog).

evidence.verified: grep -n '@keydown\|escape\|@keyup' PaymentComponent.vue → 0 keyboard listeners; grep -n '@click.self' → 0 backdrop bindings
evidence.note: Bootstrap modal (data-bs-* / appService.modalHide('#orderpayment')) MAY provide Escape — appService is application-controlled. Verified empirically would require Playwright.

findings.owner_path: FROZEN §7. Same LOCK_PAY route as L5.3-F-01.
findings.recommendation_TEXT_ONLY_NO_PATCH: If Bootstrap modal already wires Escape (likely — verify with Playwright keypress on the modal), then NO patch is needed and this finding is downgraded to INFO. If not, add document keydown listener bound to mounted()/beforeUnmount() that calls this.reset() on Escape. ~8 LOC, LOCK_PAY required.

findings.summary: POS pos-shortcuts surface (PosComponent.vue lines 268-360+) is a VISUAL panel of READY + cash-pending orders shown as cards — NOT keyboard shortcuts despite the class name. They are buttons reachable via Tab. The risk is naming-confusion at code-review time, not a user-facing keyboard gap.

evidence.verified: grep -n 'pos-shortcuts' → 30+ matches in template + style, all visual class names. No @keydown handlers tied to this surface.

findings.recommendation_TEXT_ONLY_NO_PATCH: When V1.0.2 introduces real F1..F12 shortcuts, rename CSS classes to .pos-ready-panel + .pos-cash-panel (or .pos-quick-access) to free `.pos-shortcuts` for the new keyboard surface. Pure renaming, no behavior change.

sentinel.path_normalization_note: The brief asked for tests/Feature/A11y/... but `tests/Feature/A11y/` does not exist and `tests/Feature/` is PHPUnit territory while `.spec.js` is Vitest.
